units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 58:8">Targ. Is. LVIII, 8</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 3:6">Targ. Gen. III, 6</cite>. (some ed. O. <cite ref="A01401"><he>אִיסוּ</he></cite>); a. fr.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 86a:1">B. Mets. 86ᵃ</cite> top <he>ואסו דרבי וכ׳</he> and Rabbi’s cure shall be effected through him.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 85a">B. Kam. 85ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מאי אֲסוּתֵיה</he> what is the remedy for it? <cite ref="Shabbat 110a:1">Sabb. 110ᵃ</cite> perhaps the Rabbis’ snake (excommunication) has bitten him <he>דלית ליה א׳</he> for which there is no remedy.—Pl. <he>אַסְוָון</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 58b:2">B. Bath. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>בריש כל א׳ אנא חמר</he> I, the wine, stand at the head of all medicines.—<cite ref="A01808"><he>אַסְוָותָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 113b:8">B. Mets. 113ᵇ</cite> <he>אַסְוָתַיְיהוּ</he> remedies for them.
